claim: Salim moved into a RevOps Manager role after more than a year and a half working as a GTM engineer.
Before launching campaigns or buying tools, Salim interviewed Growth, SDR and AE leadership plus individual sellers to understand the problems and priorities.
A company-classification prompt was tested manually on 100 records, then expanded to 400 and 1,000 before being applied to the full list.
A CRM cleaning and enrichment workflow covering more than 17,000 companies consumed more than 17,000 actions, prompting an evaluation of alternatives.

Salim built a Champion Moved workflow that tracks relevant contacts from client companies, checks the new company and persona against the ICP, then routes qualified records through HubSpot for Sales assignment.
